# API for Workflow Management

Reference file for [citations.md](../citations.md).

## Overview

Windmill provides a full REST API with an OpenAPI specification available at
`app.windmill.dev/openapi.html` [13]. The API supports complete CRUD
operations for scripts, flows, resources, variables, and schedules.

## Authentication

All API interactions require bearer token authentication [9]:
- Generate tokens in Account Settings
- Pass as `Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>` header
- Or as `?token=<TOKEN>` query parameter (less secure)

### Execution Trigger Modes

| Mode | Endpoint Pattern | Behavior | Source |
|------|-----------------|----------|--------|
| Async | `/api/w/$WORKSPACE/jobs/run/...` | Returns job UUID | [13] |
| Sync | `/api/w/$WORKSPACE/jobs/run_wait_result/...` | Returns result directly | [13] |
| SSE | `/api/w/:workspace/job_u/getupdate_sse/:id` | Streams updates | [13] |

### Execution Monitoring

| Operation | Details | Source |
|-----------|---------|--------|
| Get job status | Via job UUID — running, completed, logs, mem_peak, progress (0-100) | [13] |
| List jobs | With filtering by datetime, labels, worker | [13] |
| SSE progress | 100ms update intervals | [13] |

## OpenAPI / OpenFlow

Windmill uses the OpenFlow format for workflow definitions — a JSON-serializable
specification [12]. The platform can also generate OpenAPI specs from HTTP
routes and webhooks, and vice versa [10].

The full OpenAPI specification is available at:
- Web: `app.windmill.dev/openapi.html`
- GitHub: `windmill/openflow.openapi.yaml` [2]

## MCP Integration

The API is also exposed via MCP (Model Context Protocol) with 40+ tools [14]:
- listScripts, runScriptByPath, listFlows, runFlowByPath
- listResource, createResource, listJobs, listSchedules, listWorkers
- queryDocumentation (EE only)

See [ai-llm-integration.md](ai-llm-integration.md) for MCP details.

## Gaps and Limitations

- Specific API rate limits or quotas not documented
- Pagination behavior for list endpoints not detailed in accessible sources
- API versioning strategy not documented
- No gRPC API — REST only
